Name: Main Controller
Description: Central microcontroller for sensor data processing and actuator control, with integrated Wi-Fi.

Name: Solar Power Panel
Description: Converts solar energy into electrical power to charge the battery.

Name: Battery Charge Controller
Description: Manages power flow from solar panel to battery and provides regulated output for loads.

Name: System Battery
Description: Stores electrical energy for powering the system, especially during low light conditions.

Name: Rain Sensor
Description: Detects the presence of rain to trigger automatic roof closure.

Name: Ambient Light Sensor
Description: Measures ambient light intensity for automatic roof opening/closing and night mode.

Name: Soil Moisture Sensor
Description: Measures soil humidity levels to trigger automatic irrigation.

Name: Temperature & Humidity Sensor
Description: Monitors internal greenhouse temperature and humidity for ventilation control.

Name: Water Irrigation Pump
Description: Pumps water from the reservoir for automatic plant irrigation.

Name: Ventilation Fan
Description: Provides ventilation to control internal greenhouse temperature.

Name: Pump Control Relay
Description: Switches the 12V water pump on/off via MCU signal.

Name: Fan Control Relay
Description: Switches the 12V fan on/off via MCU signal.

Name: 5V Step-Down Converter
Description: Steps down 12V battery voltage to 5V for powering the ESP32 and 5V sensors.

Name: Greenhouse Frame Structure
Description: Main structural frame for the greenhouse, robust enough for 2-5 sq m roof and environmental exposure.

Name: Rainwater Reservoir
Description: Stores harvested rainwater for the irrigation system.

Name: Irrigation Tubing
Description: Delivers water from the pump to the irrigation emitters.

Name: Irrigation Drip Emitter
Description: Provides controlled water delivery to plants.

Name: Main Electronics Enclosure
Description: Houses and protects the MCU, power management, and relay modules from weather elements.

Name: Rain Sensor Enclosure
Description: Protective enclosure for the rain sensor, allowing exposure but preventing direct harsh impacts.

Name: Light Sensor Mount
Description: Mount for positioning the ambient light sensor for accurate readings.

Name: Temperature/Humidity Sensor Mount
Description: Mount for the DHT22 sensor, typically positioned inside the greenhouse.

Name: Soil Moisture Sensor Stake
Description: Stake to hold the capacitive soil moisture sensor securely in the soil.

Name: Water Pump Mount
Description: Mount for securing the submersible water pump inside the reservoir.

Name: Ventilation Fan Mount
Description: Mount and grille for the ventilation fan to be integrated into the greenhouse wall.

Name: M3 Mounting Bolt
Description: Standard bolts for mounting sensors, small modules, and 3D-printed parts.

Name: M3 Nut
Description: Used with M3 bolts.

Name: M5 Frame Bolt
Product Name: M5x16mm Hex Socket Head Cap Screw
Description: For assembling the aluminum extrusion frame and mounting heavier components like linear rails.

Name: M5 T-Nut
Description: Used with M5 bolts for connecting components to aluminum extrusions.

Name: Flexible Tent Cover
Description: Flexible, transparent UV-resistant film that serves as the roll-up cover for the greenhouse.

Name: Cover Roll-up Motor
Description: A single, self-locking worm gear motor to roll the flexible cover up and down.

Name: Cover Motor Driver
Description: A simple H-bridge motor driver to control the direction of the single cover motor.

Name: Cover Roller Tube
Description: The central tube onto which the flexible cover is rolled.

Name: Roller Support Brackets
Description: 3D printed brackets to mount the roller tube to the main greenhouse frame.

Name: Status Display
Description: A small OLED screen to display real-time sensor data like temperature and humidity.

Name: Display Mount
Description: A 3D printed enclosure and mount for the status display, attaching to the greenhouse frame.

Name: Wind Speed Sensor
Description: Measures wind speed to automatically close the tent cover during high winds for protection.

Name: Reservoir Water Level Sensor
Description: Monitors the water level in the reservoir to prevent the pump from running dry and to send low-water alerts.

Name: Cover Open Limit Switch
Description: Detects when the tent cover has reached the fully open position, preventing motor strain.

Name: Cover Closed Limit Switch
Description: Detects when the tent cover has reached the fully closed position, preventing motor strain.

Name: Battery Monitor Module
Description: Monitors battery voltage, current, and power usage for energy management and low-battery alerts.

Name: Frame Reinforcement Bracket
Description: Reinforces the corners of the main frame structure to improve rigidity and resistance to adverse weather.

Name: Wind Sensor Mount
Description: Mounts the wind speed sensor securely to the top of the greenhouse frame.

Name: Water Level Sensor Mount
Description: Holds the ultrasonic water level sensor at the top of the water reservoir, pointing downwards.

Name: Limit Switch Mount
Description: Mounts the limit switches onto the frame to be triggered by the movement of the cover mechanism.
